evidence_summary: The test `test_poc_lg001_rounding_produces_1wei_weth` scans liquidity values 1..1,000,000 and finds multiple values for which the Q64.96 math in `getAmountsForLiquidity` returns exactly 1 wei WETH (instead of 0) when the pool price is at tick 0 (parity). `test_poc_lg001_all_operations_blocked` proves that calling `updateUnderlyingAssetsBuggy()` with any such liquidity value causes a revert with 'Non zero wethAmount', blocking all deposit/withdraw/rebalance operations that call `_updateUnderlyingAssets`. `test_poc_lg001_fixed_allows_1wei_dust` confirms the fix (`require(_wethAmount <= 1)`) resolves the DoS without any other code changes.
